The Witches' Order of the Golden Dawn

The Witches' Order of the Golden Dawn is quite different from any other Golden Dawn Order you will find. After reading and re-reading the mission statement of the Witches' Order of the Golden Dawn, I cannot think of a better way to describe their specific flavor of Golden Dawn than the way they describe themselves:

The Witches’ Order of the Golden Dawn is a redaction of the original Golden Dawn system, based closely on the version of theituals handed down via the Cypher Manuscripts and by Israel Regardie. In ritual terms, we remain faithful to the Current. (As used here, the term ‘Current’ refers to the flow of magical energy which stems from the egregore / thought-form of the Golden Dawn tradition.) We differ considerably, however, in terms of the way we teach and learn. Our model is based on the way that many martial arts are taught, particularly budo taijutsu, more commonly known as ninjutsu. Our approach is summarised as follows:

-We do not require examinations or conversations before advancements may be given.

-Material from our curriculum may be studied in any order, at any time, in a manner that is suited to the learning style of the Aspirant.

-We do not mandate minimum time periods between advancements.

-We regard no material whatsoever as being above someone’s grade. Anyone may study anything they wish, and they are encouraged to learn by working magic rather than by academic study alone.

-We work in cycles. Anyone may attend any Hall, regardless of its grade relative to their own, including workings of the Second Order. Most Halls will involve at least one advancement. On reaching 5 = 6 Adeptus Minor for the first time, the aspirant is regarded as Neophyte Adeptus Minor, whereupon they begin again, starting their next cycle at 0 = 0 Neophyte. At their second 5 = 6, they are known as Zelator Adeptus Minor, and so on. As with ninjutsu, it is expected that each time around the cycle, the material is understood more deeply.

We are witches. We are practicing the Golden Dawn system of magic, as witches. The W.O.G.D. is the embodiment of this, and we make no apology for the changes that we have made, mindful that many will regard them as heretical.

There is much, much more that comprises the beliefs and philosophy of this Order, so I encourage anyone interested in this path to read more about it on the linked page.

Voat has gone invite only. Although some are celebrating this as a win so that users like Amelek can no longer create alt accounts, the truth is that this is a loss for all voat users. By only allowing certain users approve other new users, the allowance of different opinions is hindered by the biases of the select users. This escalated the censorship of unpopular opinions greatly. If an a user attracts a vote brigade against them because they posted dissent and their account is now useless because of the -50 ccp rule, there are no restarts or do overs. They can be shut off from the site permanently either by not being re-invited or losing hope in the website as unpopular opinions are not allowed. This is NOT creating a circle jerk. This is creating a secret club.

As a newer website being very popular very fast, it has a lot to learn from other websites. A perfect example is 8chan. This is because they have survived worse ddos and spamming spamming attacks and even had their domain seized and reclaimed. More recently, Old users have been attacking new users and threatening the integrity of the website because without new users, new content slows and as secret club mentality takes over, the website dies off. 8chan is the surfaceweb's true platform for free speech. This is important to note because although illegal content is banned, morally questionable content is still allowed: pedo threads , doxing, AND raids (what we call brigading). Some 8chan users proposed that they make raids against website rules in order to stop secret club mentality. Hotwheels, 8chan's owner, reluctantly argued against the new rules because although a secret club is eminent death, it is much slower death than that caused by taking away a piece of freedom of speech and expression.

You made read the archived thread here: https://archive.is/8Wbxo

or screen caps here: 1 2

I don't know how long the invite only will last. I hope not for long, but we must be ready to fight it and logically defend against why.
